question: akiendell's Postgres 17 (service postgresql-x64-17) authenticates every 127.0.0.1 line by scram-sha-256, there is no PGPASSWORD and no %APPDATA%\postgresql\pgpass.conf, and libpq defaults to role 'akien' — so the Windows bus cannot reach durable state even after db_domain learns TCP. Which role should Cairn log in as on akiendell, and will you create it (LOGIN CREATEDB) and put its password in that user's pgpass.conf, or tell CC where the postgres superuser password lives so CC can?
why_it_blocks: falsifier (a) of 5183005fa134 needs the lazily started bus on akiendell to reach db_domain; the code fix (TCP when no Unix socket) is cast separately, but the credential is a host secret only Akien holds; akiendell_cc_0 measured the failure 'fe_sendauth: no password supplied' and did not guess or reset anything.
